display.purpose: The public name and one decisive identity statement.

body.purpose: Readable profile copy and supporting text.

shadows.name: floating-sheet
shadows.purpose: Centers a narrow paper surface above the desktop stage.

shadows.name: pressed-action
shadows.purpose: Gives the primary mobile action physical response.

motion.name: paper-settle
motion.purpose: Brings the waving character into place once without hiding it.

motion.name: tactile-response
motion.purpose: Handles hover, focus-adjacent, and pressed feedback.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single full-width action that opens the full portfolio.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:56px; padding:14px 17px; border-radius:15px; background:#315fbe; color:#f8faff; font:700 17px/1 'Cabin Sketch',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:5px 7px 16px rgb(49 95 190 / 28%); transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-primary-action:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #214b9f; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-primary-action:active { transform:translateY(1px) scale(.985); box-shadow:3px 4px 10px rgb(49 95 190 / 24%); }

components.name: Compact Share Control
components.description: A small utility control with persistent text feedback.
components.css: .ds-share { min-width:96px; min-height:46px; padding:10px 15px; border:1px solid #555b64; border-radius:999px; background:#fcfcf8; color:#17191d; font:700 17px/1 'Cabin Sketch',sans-serif; transition:color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-share:hover { color:#315fbe; background:#eef3fb; } .ds-share:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #214b9f; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-share:active { transform:scale(.97); }

components.name: Profile Link Row
components.description: A flat destination row with a factual handle and generous touch height.
components.css: .ds-link-row { display:flex; min-height:70px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding:10px 3px; border-bottom:1px solid #a5adb8; color:#17191d; font:400 17px/1.2 'Cabin Sketch',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),padding 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-link-row span:first-child { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; } .ds-link-row small { color:#555b64; font-size:15px; } .ds-link-row:hover { padding-left:7px; padding-right:7px; color:#315fbe; } .ds-link-row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #214b9f; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-link-row:active { transform:scale(.985); }

components.name: Mobile Paper Sheet
components.description: The edge-to-edge mobile surface that becomes a narrow floating sheet on larger screens.
components.css: .ds-paper-sheet { width:min(100%,460px); min-height:520px; padding:20px; border-radius:28px; background:#f7f7f3; color:#17191d; box-shadow:10px 14px 26px rgb(34 49 67 / 18%),0 30px 72px rgb(34 49 67 / 18%); } .ds-paper-sheet h2 { margin:0; font:400 64px/.94 'Rubik Scribble',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-paper-sheet p { font:700 22px/1.05 'Cabin Sketch',sans-serif; } @media(max-width:599px){ .ds-paper-sheet { width:100%; min-height:100dvh; border-radius:0; box-shadow:none; } }

components.name: Skip Link
components.description: A keyboard-only shortcut that becomes visible on focus.
components.css: .ds-skip-link { display:inline-block; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:10px; background:#17191d; color:#f7f7f3; font:700 16px/1 'Cabin Sketch',sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transform:translateY(-160%); transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-skip-link:focus { transform:translateY(0); outline:3px solid #214b9f; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface feels like Danis' drawings have become a navigable place. Paper texture, imperfect ink lines, local sketch lettering, and illustrated characters carry the identity. Digital controls remain obvious and responsive, but their physical press and offset depth make them belong to the same world.

The main portfolio can use spatial WebGL, while lightweight surfaces preserve the same personality through real artwork and tactile CSS. Expression is concentrated in one memorable illustrated moment. Information, actions, and accessibility remain direct.
keyCharacteristics: Real hand-drawn artwork leads the composition.
Paper and graphite form the neutral foundation.
Blueprint blue is the only chromatic accent.
Motion welcomes or confirms; it does not decorate every element.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: Blueprint is the only accent family. New semantic colors appear only for a real success or error state.

rules.name: The Paper Stays Paper Rule
rules.body: Texture supports the subject's physical world and never becomes a generic grain overlay.

rules.name: The Scribble Is a Signature Rule
rules.body: Rubik Scribble is reserved for identity-scale display text, never paragraphs or utility labels.

rules.name: The One Elevation Signal Rule
rules.body: A component uses either a border or a shadow as its primary edge signal, not both.

dos: Do reuse real portfolio artwork and local fonts before inventing new visual assets.
Do keep primary actions visible in the first mobile viewport.
Do maintain 44px or larger touch targets and safe-area spacing.
Do support both paper-light and blueprint-dark themes.
Do keep copy factual and tied to portfolio evidence.
donts: Don't turn the system into a generic glass card or neon technology theme.
Don't load WebGL, audio, custom cursors, or heavy texture preloads on lightweight routes.
Don't use equal icon-card grids as the default information structure.
Don't add unconfirmed contact details, metrics, clients, or availability claims.
Don't hide useful content based on user-agent detection.
